expectedRealization.rationale: Cobalt scarcity and company earnings can remain strong for several quarters, but after a very large commodity/equity rerating the base-horizon decision must focus on residual expectation room rather than physical tightness alone.

acceptableExpressionSet.rationale: Huayou had direct cobalt exposure, 2017 profit guided +2283% to +2644%, and a current March forecast implying ~22.3x 2018E PE, but its 60d benchmark excess was already ~48.7pp and cobalt spot had nearly tripled from July 2016.
Hanrui had direct cobalt exposure and a cutoff-valid 2018Q1 profit forecast +395% to +425%, but its equity had also already rerated materially over 60d.

changeHypothesis.summary: Cobalt supply remained concentrated and constrained while battery demand supported pricing. Direct A-share producers already showed extraordinary realized/forecast earnings, but commodity and equity prices had rerated so strongly that the key question was no longer whether scarcity existed, but whether any residual expectation gap remained.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Mine/refining supply responds slowly and battery demand can sustain tightness across quarters.
disconfirmingEvidence: Domestic cobalt price was already nearly triple its July 2016 level.
Huayou 60d benchmark excess was about +48.7pp and all frozen cobalt expressions beat CSI300 over 20d and 60d.
Current forecasts already embedded very large 2018 profit growth.
